# Cellebrite names Shiven Ramji CEO, cuts 2026 revenue outlook
[Company News](https://www.investing.com/news/company-news)
Published08/13/2026, 07:04 AM
Cellebrite names Shiven Ramji CEO, cuts 2026 revenue outlook
View all comments (0) 0
Cellebrite names Shiven Ramji CEO, cuts 2026 revenue outlook
View all comments (0) 0
© Reuters
© Reuters

...

TYSONS CORNER, Va. and PETAH TIKVA, Israel - Cellebrite DI Ltd. ( NASDAQ:CLBT ) announced today that Shiven Ramji has succeeded Thomas E. Hogan as chief executive officer, effective immediately. Ramji joined the company as President, Products and Technology in May 2026.
The leadership change accompanies the company’s second-quarter 2026 results and a revised full-year outlook. Cellebrite lowered its fiscal 2026 annual recurring revenue guidance to $550 million to $560 million, representing 14% to 16% growth, down from previous expectations.

...

Hogan joined Cellebrite as Executive Chairman in August 2023, became interim CEO in January 2025, and was appointed CEO in August 2025. He will step down from the CEO role but his future involvement with the company was not specified in the statement.
